substantive_conclusion: The strict Taiwan court-corpus pass found no novel verified China transplant-brokerage event beyond the known Changhua prosecution and its appeal. A wider pass separately identified a Southeast Asia scam-compound trafficking matter containing explicit organ-removal discussions, but no completed procurement or prisoner-to-recipient chain.
evidence_boundary: Paid brokerage, a threat or discussion of organ removal, or opaque provenance is not proof that a prisoner supplied an organ.
